title: Shakshuka
steps: Finely chop the brown onion, dice the red capsicum and crush the garlic.
Heat a splash of olive oil in a large deep frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and capsicum, stirring now and then, for 6-8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, tomato paste, ground cumin, paprika and chilli flakes (skip the flakes for a milder sauce). Stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Tip in the diced tomatoes with their juices, season with salt and pepper, and simmer uncovered for 12-15 minutes until the sauce is thick enough to hold its shape when you drag a spoon through it.
Press 6 wells into the sauce with the back of a spoon and crack an egg into each.
Cover the pan and cook on low for 6-8 minutes, until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still runny.
Scatter over the crumbled vegetarian feta and chopped parsley, and serve straight from the pan.
